B1.decision: v2 ships as a separate Chakra theme (src/theme/horizon.ts), not merged into the legacy theme. Twelve token names collide with different values between the two systems; a separate theme lets v2 keep the clean names while every production route stays pixel-identical on the legacy theme. Page migration becomes a provider swap in main.tsx plus deletion of the legacy theme, with no rename of call sites. Owner decision, 2026-09-10.

corrections: Breakpoints were first set to 375/768/1024/1440, which are DESIGN.md's review widths, not layout transitions. The approved prototype changes layout at max-width 680 and 1000 (with secondary tweaks at 800 and 1168), so breakpoints are now sm 681 / md 801 / lg 1001 / xl 1169 and the review widths live separately as reviewWidths. Surfaced by dsv2.3.1 AC 1; corrected before B2 started.
The type ramp switched at lg, which would have left tablets on mobile heading sizes. It now switches at sm (681px), matching the prototype query that drops heading sizes.

notes: Polymorphism uses explicit element unions (RegionElement, CollectionElement, HeadingElement, TextElement) instead of Chakra's open As, so an invalid element is a compile error. No any.
Field wiring is taken from context by the control, not passed per control, so aria-describedby and aria-invalid cannot be attached to one field and forgotten on the next.
Current nav item is signalled by aria-current plus a persistent indicator and colour, never by hover or by a font-weight change (a weight change would rewrap a horizontal nav on every navigation).
known_gaps: Button and IconButton use Chakra's default spinner speed: the token source has no spin duration, and passing one would be a raw ms value.
Divider forwards no ref because its two branches render hr and div and one ref type cannot honestly describe both.
Radio ships without a RadioGroup; it is not in the ticket's component list and callers pair it with Field control="group" plus Chakra's RadioGroup.
Control size sm sits below the 44px touch floor. meetsTouchTarget records this rather than hiding it; whether each sm usage genuinely lacks space is a B6 review call.

notes: The media reducer is total: an event that does not apply returns the identical object, so a stale load event from a replaced element cannot corrupt state. It includes ready -> error, an image breaking after it was shown.

Retry calls an injected resolveSource({attempt, previousSrc}) so a fresh signed URL is possible; with no resolver the element is keyed on src#attempt so the browser re-requests. No URL mutation in a render component.
mediaFrameStyle takes only aspectRatio and radius. Status is not an argument, so layout cannot vary by state - the invariant is structural, not merely asserted.
Alt vs decorative is enforced at the type level and a blank alt throws, with the error naming the decorative escape hatch.
One reduced-motion policy (useMotionPolicy) collapses both duration and delay to zero and drops fades rather than shortening them.
known_gaps: PageLoading, PanelLoading and InlineLoading share one file as scopes of a single LoadingIndicator rather than three near-empty modules.
The loading pulse uses keyframes from @emotion/react (an existing direct dependency) because Chakra v2.8 re-exports it at runtime but not in its types.

notes: Signature and ordinary cards differ on surface family, radius and title ramp at once, so they cannot be collapsed into one card with a size prop.

The rail is a scroll container, never a translated track, so finger, trackpad, scrollbar, Tab and screen-reader scrolling all keep working. Overlay arrows are an addition to scrolling, never a replacement.
Rail position is hidden visually when the controls already carry it but still announced ('Series 3 of 8').
Overlay-arrow translucency is derived from action.subtle having an alpha channel, so retuning that token to an opaque value fails a test rather than silently changing the design.
localScrollStyle asserts minWidth: 0 alongside overflowX: auto - the flex/grid min-width:auto default is the actual cause of horizontal document scroll.
known_gaps: Copy confirmation has no auto-reset timer. The prototype held it ~1.8s; no token is near that value and inventing one in a component breaks the raw-value rule. CodeBlock resets on pointerleave/blur instead. Needs a confirmation-hold duration token in B1 if a timed hold is wanted.

PostCard's cover is inset rather than full-bleed as the prototype draws it. MediaFrame always applies a radius and Surface owns the card's, so full-bleed would need one of them to surrender its radius from outside - the exact thing CONVENTIONS rule 4 forbids. Needs an explicit B6 decision.

SeriesManager is only partially discharged: ManageSeriesItem (the row) plus reorder/dirty logic exist, but the surrounding form (title, description, add-a-blog, save/delete) is a workspace surface straddling B5's editor area. The inventory row is NOT fully covered - assign it before B6 signs off.
The Signature pointer light is absent: the prototype's own final stylesheet disables it, its gradient is not a token, and DESIGN.md lists 'random glow' under Avoid. Entry motion is a Reveal instead.

ShareAction's menu trigger widens Button to ElementType for Chakra's polymorphic as, because our Button narrows Chakra's props and MergeWithAs cannot infer it. A widening, not an unsafe cast, but the one place the type system does less work.

notes: publicationCopy is test-locked: a scheduled post shows 'Draft - scheduled', says no reader can open it yet, and never contains the word published.
permissionRowState().displayedRole always equals serverRole across all five states including in-flight and refused, so a permission change is never shown optimistically as done.
destructiveGate blocks on server denial ahead of anything the reader types into a confirmation box.
A metric display containing '~' can never exist without an 'Approx.' marker and a spoken 'approximate' label.

No charting library was added: Trend, Funnel and Breakdown are inline SVG with token-sized bars, compensating for the missing axes and tooltips with a text summary as the figure's accessible name and the full series in a details table.
known_gaps: SCHEDULE_GRACE_MS duplicates the 5-minute constant in src/features/profile/schedule-display.utils.ts. It cannot be imported without a design-system -> features dependency, so it is a documented default parameter citing its source. If the worker window changes, two places need updating. Resolve at dsv2.7.3.
AuthFailureReason is a small presentation union, not the backend's OAuth error codes; the feature keeps that mapping.
chartMotion(policy) ignores its argument by design - the geometry is never animated - and keeps the parameter so the property stays visible and a future change breaks a test.

B6.defect_found_and_fixed: A busy control painted itself as a disabled one. Loading sets aria-disabled=true to keep focus while refusing clicks, but Chakra styles _disabled on [aria-disabled=true] too, so a working button took the disabled fill: 1.81:1 light, 1.64:1 dark against a 4.5:1 floor. WCAG 1.4.3 exempts inactive components, not busy ones. Fixed in src/theme/horizon.ts for both routes into the state (our aria-busy and Chakra's data-loading), locked by a test. Rendered failures 18 -> 2, the remaining 2 being genuinely disabled controls. Invisible to every unit test in the epic and to both bundle agents - only findable by rendering.
B6.not_verified: Component-level responsive collapse (the gallery's own shell does not collapse and its viewport control constrains a frame rather than firing media queries), screen-reader output, print, real touch gestures on the rail, and OS-level prefers-reduced-motion.

PostCard cover: FULL-BLEED, matching the approved prototype. Resolved by making the deferral explicit in the API - a media frame can decline to own its corners, a surface can clip its children - so exactly one visual owner remains rather than an outside override.

orchestrator_fixes: mediaState maxAttempts had 0 meaning unlimited, the opposite of how the number reads, which left 'offer no retry' inexpressible - the case a 24px avatar needs, where a retry button is a keyboard stop for nothing. 0 now means no retries and Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY means unlimited; the old behaviour's test was replaced by one for each end.

The top-level barrel surfaced two cross-bundle name collisions that neither agent could see alone. patterns/series re-declared RailDirection instead of using the navigation primitive's type: the duplicate is deleted and the type imported. patterns/posts and patterns/editor both exported removeTag for genuinely different jobs (a filter tag versus a post's own tags); the filter one is now removeFilterTag.
